jobs: A medieval battering ram siege engine: a heavy oak log with an iron ram's-head cap slung on ropes under a steep pitched shingle roof, the whole machine on four solid wooden wheels, a magenta pink pennant on the roof ridge. Seen from the front-left at a true 2:1 isometric angle, pointing to the lower right, the way a unit is drawn in Age of Empires 2.

A medieval trebuchet siege engine: a tall timber A-frame on a heavy beamed base, a long throwing arm raised with a sling, a big boxed stone counterweight hanging at the short end, a winch and rope, a pile of stone shot beside it, a magenta pink pennant on the frame. Seen from the front-left at a true 2:1 isometric angle, facing to the lower right, the way a unit is drawn in Age of Empires 2.
